PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp Block (10-14 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "restore baseline strength and movement"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Full Body Acclimatisation":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squat 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
          cat_cow 1m
      DAY Thursday training 35m "Core & Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x20s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Full Body Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
          cat_cow 1m
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Core & Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          push_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
          cat_cow 1m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Core & Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Baseline":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          push_up 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
          cat_cow 1m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Core & Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
